notes.name: ad586_reference.md
notes.text:
AD586 reference GUI notes:
- Reference_Voltage:AD586 exposes functional pins 2 supply, 4 GND, 5 TRIM, 6 VOUT, 8 NR; NC pins are omitted.
- Device:R_Potentiometer defaults to pin 1 up, pin 3 down, wiper pin 2 right. Suitable left of AD586.
- Local label: hover wire, lowercase l, inspect dialog, type text, verify, OK (719,710), click anchor on wire, Esc.
- Plain GND can be duplicated with Ctrl+D and placed directly at return pin endpoints. Verify attachment visually.
- Ctrl+S removed title asterisk and status explicitly confirmed /home/cua/kicad_project/ad586_reference.kicad_sch saved.
- Current task is visually checked against design; evaluator score unavailable. Prior scores support successful GUI value edits, but multiple full designs scored 0.00 or partially, so visual completion alone does not establish exact reference matching.
